description: This Dart script determines and prints the absolute path to the root directory of a specific Flutter project. It checks for the existence of key project files (pubspec.yaml and lib/main.dart) to verify the project root, and exits with status 0 if found, or 2 if not.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the script that determines the Flutter project root directory and outputs its path or an error message, exiting with code 0 or 2 accordingly.
